title: Light Steamed Dutch Lentils Dal
description: A rich, light, weeknight Dutch dish featuring brown lentils, steamed to perfection in a mason jar. This egg-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and drain well.
In a mason jar, combine the lentils, onion, garlic, carrot, celery, and tomato paste.
Add 2 cups of water to the mason jar, leaving about 1 inch of space at the top.
Place the mason jar in a pot of boiling water, making sure the water level is below the top of the jar.
Cover the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and steam for 25 minutes.
Remove the mason jar from the pot and let it cool slightly before serving.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
Note: Before reheating, always check the temperature of the lentils to ensure they are cooked through and at a safe temperature.
Strain the broth before reheating if desired.
